text: The Kunneth short exact sequence computes $H_n(A\otimes B)$ from the tensor products $H_p(A)\otimes H_q(B)$ together with a correction term built from the derived functor ___.
explanation: The Kunneth formula reads $0\to\bigoplus H_p(A)\otimes H_q(B)\to H_n(A\otimes B)\to\bigoplus\mathrm{Tor}_1(H_p(A),H_q(B))\to 0$, so the correction term is a Tor group (specifically $\mathrm{Tor}_1$). It is not $\mathrm{Ext}$ (which governs universal-coefficient cohomology) and not an ordinary tensor product.
